videos.title: Why the Lemur Wins Fights With Its Smell #Shorts

comments.author: @brianmcclenahan617
comments.replyText: Great point! Skunks definitely weaponize scent too, but they spray predators in self-defense. Lemurs are the only ones known to use body odor in combat with their OWN kind to settle territorial disputes. Both are amazing examples of chemical warfare in nature.
